{{recipe}}

'''Chicken Parisian''' is a slow-cooker recipe containing chicken, rice, wine, and cream of mushroom soup. Prepare this before lunch starts to have it in time for supper.

==Ingredients==
*Red or white [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]] (use cooking wine for more flavor)
*Canned cream of mushroom soup
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinches]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] (optional)
*Boneless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] pieces
*1 container [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
*Steamed [[Cookbook:Rice|white rice]]

==Procedure==
#Mix the wine and cream of mushroom soup together in a [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|slow-cooker]]. If you added too much wine, sprinkle in some flour to keep the sauce from losing viscosity.
#Take the chicken cuts, strip off the fat, and rinse well. Immerse the chicken in the sauce mixture in the slow-cooker. Be sure to fully submerge the chicken.
#Mix in sour cream, put the lid on, and set the slow-cooker to cook for 8 hours on low heat.
#Serve the finished chicken with the steamed rice.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If storing for leftovers, be sure to refrigerate the sauce and rice in separate containers.
